extraction.Name: John Galligo, senior
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent to his 640 acre allotment at the time he got it, but was informed that it was recorded in the court house, that he would have the taxes to pay, and failing in this, that the land would be put up for sale; so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold a half section of his allotment, to Herman Vahernkamp, of White Clay, Nebraska, for $1200.00, receiving $600.00 in cash and a trade in horses, seven head
extraction.Buyer: Herman Vahernkamp, of White Clay, Nebraska, for $1200.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: he farms his other half section, and works on farms for other people, this being the only source of income he has
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health not good, he having catarrh; has a wife and six children to support; the family is tubercular; he considers that he got a pretty bum price for his place; has never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; document dated November 24, 1928
